items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: But I guess he's just going to be general booking agent.

ctx.x: What was Clarence Williams doing in this group? Did he sing or play piano some time? Well...
He sang some time. He played piano some time. But I guess he's just going to be general booking agent. Whatever you might call it.
For the booking agent. For the group. For the group, really.
